'''Ice Storm''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtrooper]] unit, an elite formation within the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] specializing in cold-weather operations.
